name: match-frame
description: Match-frame brand reels (9:16): beat-synced hard cuts between light/dark shot pairs with the logo held on one match point

scripts.sheet: npx remotion still src/index.ts ContactSheet out/contact-sheet.png
scripts.still: npx remotion still src/index.ts MatchFrame out/still.png --frame=0
scripts.render:preview: npx remotion render src/index.ts MatchFrame out/preview.mp4 --scale=0.5
scripts.render: npx remotion render src/index.ts MatchFrame out/match-frame.mp4 && python3 scripts/align_audio.py out/match-frame.mp4 public/audio/ref-streak.m4a --upload
scripts.render:ramp: npx remotion render src/index.ts MatchFrameRamp out/match-frame-ramp.mp4 && python3 scripts/align_audio.py out/match-frame-ramp.mp4 public/audio/ref-skillshift.m4a --upload
scripts.textures: for t in LogoMask LockupMask ScreenA ScreenB; do npx remotion still src/index.ts $t blender/build/$t.png --image-format=png || exit 1; done
